heroTitle: AI already at work in companies — see it in a keynote
lead: For events, conventions, and board meetings: discover what artificial intelligence already solves in business today, with live demonstrations of agents in operation on SON.IA.
contextTitle: How do you bring the AI conversation closer to business reality?
context: At events and leadership gatherings, the challenge can be moving beyond abstract ideas to discuss concrete applications. The keynote presents current AI possibilities in a business context through live demonstrations of agents in operation on SON.IA.
solutionTitle: A conversation about current applications, with demonstrations
solutionText: Onsmart.AI AI keynotes are designed for events, conventions, and board meetings. The content shows what AI already solves in companies today and includes live demonstrations of agents in operation on SON.IA. Specific topic, duration, format, and audience fit must be aligned before engagement.
audiences: Companies hosting conventions and internal gatherings
Leadership teams interested in discussing AI applications in business

goals.title: Make the topic more concrete
goals.text: Present examples of current AI applications in companies, without promising specific outcomes for the participating organization.

goals.title: Encourage an informed conversation
goals.text: Provide context so participants can discuss AI possibilities in their business environment.

goals.title: Demonstrate agents in operation
goals.text: Show agents in operation on SON.IA live, as proposed and subject to technical conditions confirmed for the event.

flow.title: Event alignment
flow.text: Confirm audience, objective, context, and needs of the session with the Onsmart.AI team.

flow.title: Scope definition
flow.text: Validate topic, format, duration, required resources, and availability; these details are not specified in public materials.

flow.title: Keynote delivery
flow.text: Present the agreed content and, when confirmed in scope, run live demonstrations of agents in operation on SON.IA.

methodology: The briefing does not define methodology, standard agenda, or official duration. Content, dynamics, in-person or remote format, technical requirements, and any audience adaptation must be confirmed and documented in the commercial proposal; the steps above are a consultative structure for alignment, not an officially contracted method.
deliverables: Keynote for event, convention, or board meeting — scope, duration, and format to be confirmed in proposal.
Live demonstration of agents in operation on SON.IA, subject to scope validation and technical conditions.
Content and supporting materials, if any — existence and format to be confirmed before engagement.

differentiators.title: Business focus
differentiators.text: The topic is what AI already solves in companies today, as described in the briefing.

differentiators.title: Live demonstrations
differentiators.text: The proposal includes live demonstrations of agents in operation on SON.IA; feasibility for each event must be confirmed.

differentiators.title: Built for leadership and events
differentiators.text: The offering is suited to events, conventions, and board meetings.

faqs.q: Can the keynote be in person or online?
faqs.a: Format is not stated in available materials. Contact the team to validate options for your event.

faqs.q: What is the duration and which topics are covered?
faqs.a: Duration and detailed agenda are not publicly defined. These points should be aligned with the audience and event objective.

faqs.q: Is the SON.IA demonstration included in every keynote?
faqs.a: The briefing provides for live demonstrations of agents in operation on SON.IA, but inclusion and technical conditions for each event must be confirmed in the proposal.

faqs.q: Are materials or a recording available after the keynote?
faqs.a: Materials do not specify post-event deliverables or recording authorization. Confirm these items before engagement.

faqs.q: What are the timelines and engagement terms?
faqs.a: Availability, timelines, pricing, and commercial terms are not stated on this page. Request a conversation for validation and a proposal.
